# Message scroller

A scrolling list of messages that keeps the newest in view.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Brand expressive</span> Brand expressive keeps only the parts in use for one action and a story, not a part for one campaign. A live conversation is neither. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./card">Card</a></span></p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** A live conversation where new messages arrive at the bottom.
- **Not when:** A static list (a scroll area).

Instead:

- [Scroll area](./scroll-area.md): A plain scrolling region.

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] New messages are announced politely without moving focus. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add message-scroller
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Variables

Every token Message scroller reads, from its code: the variable, the semantic token it aliases, and where that ends in the theme.

### Read straight from the system

Message scroller has no variables of its own yet; it reads these system tokens directly.
